::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 14th 1857  
**Manuscript:** MS Westcountry Studies Library, Exeter/ Yonge 1857/ 3
:::

Dear [Miss Smith](people/person_263.qmd)
I hope that in a day or two you will receive the proof of your [Royal Household](other_books/otherbook_262.qmd), which I should be much obliged to you to look over and return to

[Messrs Mozley](organizations/other_108.qmd)

Friar Gate

Derby

I am setting off to see the Manchester Exhibition[^1] and from thence most probably to Ireland, so that you may judge my time and head are not in the most favorable state for correcting

yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: The Manchester Art Treasures Exhibition, which had opened in May 1857.
